title: Zesty German Cheese Toast
description: A savory, nostalgic German dish featuring a crispy crust and a gooey parmesan cheese pull, perfect for any meal.
instructions: Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Brush the butter-parmesan mixture evenly onto each bread slice.
Crack the eggs into a separate bowl and whisk them lightly.
Brush the egg mixture onto each bread slice, making sure to get it all over the surface.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the bread in half lengthwise and serve warm, with the parmesan cheese pull still gooey.
Repeat as needed to feed a crowd.
If desired, add additional parmesan cheese on top of the bread for extra cheesiness.
